technical documentation process validation chemistry tutoring unknown,"We are looking for an experienced process chemistry / pharmaceutical synthesis consultant or technical team to independently review an existing synthesis process and, if selected, provide remote technical guidance throughout the project.

We already have a detailed working synthesis document for R-(+)-Etomidate freebase (CAS 33125-97-2). The document includes the proposed route, starting material, material calculations, reaction sequence, workup, purification, analytical controls, equipment, and a number of parameters that still require technical confirmation.
The Current Detailed Synthesis Process will be provided as an attachment to this job post.

This is not a request to develop an entirely new route from zero. We want a qualified consultant/team to critically evaluate the process we already have, identify problems, correct them, and determine whether the overall process is technically workable.
Important Selection Process
Before we establish the paid project milestones, we require applicants to review the attached synthesis document as part of their proposal.

Your proposal should demonstrate that you have actually reviewed the document and should identify and correct the important technical issues you find. We are specifically looking for an independent assessment rather than a general statement that the process “looks feasible.”
Please review, as applicable:
chemical identities and starting-material suitability
CAS numbers and molecular-weight information
route feasibility and reaction logic
stoichiometry, equivalents, quantities, concentrations, and theoretical yield
reagent and solvent selection
order of addition
reaction conditions and missing parameters
quench strategy
pH and workup logic
extraction and washing sequence
concentration and isolation strategy
purification / crystallization concept
drying approach
analytical and in-process controls
chemical and chiral-purity considerations
equipment suitability
scale-up considerations and process-safety concerns
inconsistencies, unsupported assumptions, or technically unsuitable steps
chemicals, solvents, consumables, analytical standards, and equipment that would actually need to be procured.
Where you believe something in the submitted process is incorrect, please explain what should be corrected and the technical basis for your conclusion.

Where a parameter cannot responsibly be confirmed from literature or calculations alone, please identify it clearly as requiring experimental/process-development confirmation rather than guessing a value.
Why We Require This Before the Contract Milestones
The preliminary technical review will serve three purposes:
First, it will allow us to determine whether the proposed process is technically feasible and whether the consultant has the level of expertise required for the project.
Second, it will allow us to establish an accurate procurement list before purchasing chemicals, materials, analytical standards, or equipment locally.
Third, it will be our go/no-go decision point for consultant selection.
If we approve your technical assessment and believe your corrected process framework is suitable for our project, we will then formally engage you and establish the paid milestones.
Scope After Selection
The selected consultant/team will then support the project remotely through completion.

The paid engagement is expected to include review of the finalized working process, technical guidance during each agreed laboratory stage, review of observations and analytical results, troubleshooting, process adjustments where justified, purification and analytical guidance, and technical support through successful completion of the agreed project scope.

Our team will handle the formal documentation and laboratory execution. Your role will primarily be technical review, process chemistry guidance, analytical interpretation, troubleshooting, and process-development support.
Preferred Expertise

We are particularly interested in a consultant or team with strong experience in pharmaceutical/API process chemistry, heterocyclic chemistry, oxidation chemistry, hydrogen-peroxide processes, process scale-up, crystallization/purification, HPLC/chiral analysis, and chemical process safety.
Experience reviewing patents and primary literature and distinguishing experimentally demonstrated conditions from unvalidated scale-up assumptions is important.
Proposal Instructions
Please do not submit a generic proposal.
Start your proposal with:
“I have reviewed the attached synthesis process.”
Then provide your preliminary technical assessment and identify the major corrections or unresolved issues you believe should be addressed.
Also include your relevant experience, examples of comparable process-development work, who will be involved if you are applying as a team, and how you would support us remotely after selection.
Budget and Milestones
The anticipated total consulting budget for the subsequent paid engagement is approximately USD 1,300, subject to final agreement on scope.
We do not want to establish the paid milestones until we have reviewed and approved the applicant’s preliminary technical assessment.

Once a consultant/team is selected and the corrected process framework is accepted as suitable for us to proceed, we will jointly define the project milestones and begin the formal paid Short-Form Video Editor who understands that great short-form content is about more than just making videos look good. You should have a strong sense of hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, and what makes people stop scrolling and keep watching.
We will provide the raw footage, and your job will be to turn it into engaging 15–60 second vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.

You’ll be responsible for producing a minimum of 5 finished videos per week, with the opportunity to scale the volume over time. For every video, we also want two genuinely different opening hooks so we can test which approach performs better.
What You’ll Do
Edit 15–60 second vertical short-form videos
Create at least 5 finished videos per week
Develop two different hooks for each video
Improve retention through pacing, structure, and storytelling
Add captions, B-roll, graphics, music, sound effects, and pattern interrupts when useful
Adapt videos appropriately for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts
Maintain a consistent visual style across content
Review performance metrics after videos are published
Identify patterns between high-performing and low-performing content
Use performance data to improve future hooks, pacing, and editing decisions
Test different creative approaches, messages, and formats
Keep footage, project files, versions, and final assets properly organized
What We’re Looking For

A short-form video portfolio is required. We are specifically looking for someone experienced with performance-driven social content rather than someone focused primarily on cinematic or long-form editing.
You should have:
Proven experience editing TikToks, Reels, Shorts, or similar vertical content
Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and short-form storytelling
Good knowledge of current social media editing styles and formats
Ability to create different hooks from the same raw footage
Strong instincts for what keeps viewers watching
Understanding of metrics such as watch time, retention, completion rate, shares, saves, and engagement
Ability to analyze why a video performed well or poorly
Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality
Strong attention to detail
Ability to take feedback and make quick iterations
Good file and project organization
Genuine interest in understanding why certain content performs better than other content
You should also actively consume short-form content and have a good understanding of what is currently working across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
Bonus Experience
Experience with any of the following is a plus:
DIY or home improvement content
Consumer education or technology
DTC brands
Educational or explainer videos
Performance marketing creative
Repurposing organic content into paid social advertisements
How We Measure Success
This role is not simply about producing more videos. We want to build a content process that improves over time.
We’ll be looking at questions such as:
Which hook kept people watching?
Where are viewers dropping off?
Which edits improve retention?
What makes people share or save a video?
Which formats generate stronger engagement?
Which videos drive audience growth?
What should we change in the next edit?
Performance will be evaluated through content output, retention, watch time, engagement, audience growth, and the ability to identify and improve winning creative concepts.
Compensation
This is a remote position. We are open to different compensation structures, including:
Per-video payment
Monthly retainer
Contract engagement

For the right person, there is potential for a long-term or full-time opportunity as the content operation grows. Additional performance-based bonuses may also be available for exceptional results.
